letters.topic: circuit complexity: the circuit size of a graph's edge function
letters.why: Our own checked rows give matching lower and upper bounds for the circuit size of a graph's edge function on several sparse classes of graphs. Before calling it anything, we asked a specialist in circuit complexity whether the value is already known, or follows quickly from a known method.
